units.zh: 王者制事立法，物度軌則，壹稟於六律，六律為萬事根本焉。
units.en: Kings establish institutions and laws; all measures and norms derive from the six pitch-pipes. The six pitch-pipes are the root of all affairs.
units.literal: Kings establish affairs make laws, things measure tracks rules, one receive from six pitchpipes, six pitchpipes are ten thousand affairs root there.

units.zh: 其於兵械尤所重，故云「望敵知吉凶，聞聲效勝負」，百王不易之道也。
units.en: This is especially important in military affairs. Hence, the saying: 'Gaze at the enemy to know auspicious and inauspicious; hear the sound to discern victory and defeat.' This is the unchanging way of the hundred kings.
units.literal: Its at weapons especially what heavy, therefore say "gaze enemy know auspicious inauspicious, hear sound imitate victory defeat", hundred kings unchanging way also.

units.zh: 武王伐紂，吹律聽聲，推孟春以至于季冬，殺氣相并，而音尚宮。
units.en: When King Wu campaigned against Zhou, he blew the pitch-pipes and listened to the sounds, extending this from the first month of spring to the last month of winter. The killing qi joined together, but the sound still favored gong.
units.literal: Wu King attacked Zhou, blew pitchpipes listened sound, extended first spring to last winter, killing qi mutually joined, but sound still palace.

units.zh: 同聲相從，物之自然，何足怪哉？
units.en: Like sounds mutually follow each other; this is the natural way of things. What is there to be surprised about?
units.literal: Same sound mutually follow, things natural, what sufficient strange?

units.zh: 兵者，聖人所以討彊暴，平亂世，夷險阻，救危殆。
units.en: Weapons are what sages use to punish the strong and violent, pacify chaotic ages, level dangerous obstacles, and rescue those in peril.
units.literal: Weapons, what sages use to punish the strong and violent, pacify chaotic ages, level dangerous obstacles, and rescue those in peril.

units.zh: 自含（血）［齒］戴角之獸見犯則校，而況於人懷好惡喜怒之氣？
units.en: Even beasts with teeth and horns fight when they are offended. How much more so for people who harbor the qi of likes, dislikes, joy, and anger?
units.literal: Even beasts with teeth and horns fight when offended; how much more so people who harbor likes, dislikes, joy, and anger?

units.zh: 喜則愛心生，怒則毒螫加，情性之理也。
units.en: When happy, then loving hearts are born; when angry, then poisonous stings are added. This is the principle of feelings and nature.
units.literal: Happy then love heart born, angry then poison sting add, feelings nature principle also.

units.zh: 昔黃帝有涿鹿之戰，以定火災；
units.en: Formerly the Yellow Emperor had the battle of Zhuolu, to settle the fire disaster.
units.literal: Former Yellow Emperor had Zhuolu battle, to settle fire disaster;

units.zh: 顓頊有共工之陳，以平水害；
units.en: Zhuanxu had the battle array of Gonggong, to pacify the water harm.
units.literal: Zhuanxu had Gonggong battle array, to pacify water harm;

units.zh: 成湯有南巢之伐，以殄夏亂。
units.en: Cheng Tang had the attack on Nanchao, to exterminate the Xia chaos.
units.literal: Cheng Tang had Nanchao attack, to exterminate Xia chaos.

units.zh: 遞興遞廢，勝者用事，所受於天也。
units.en: They alternately rise and alternately are abandoned; the victors use affairs. This is what is received from Heaven.
units.literal: Alternately rise alternately abandon, victors use affairs, what received from heaven also.

units.zh: 自是之後，名士迭興，晉用咎犯，而齊用王子，吳用孫武，申明軍約，賞罰必信，卒伯諸侯，兼列邦土，雖不及三代之誥誓，然身寵君尊，當世顯揚，可不謂榮焉？
units.en: From this time onward, famous scholars alternately rose. Jin used Jiu Fan, Qi used Wang Zi, Wu used Sun Wu. They explained and clarified army covenants; rewards and punishments were trustworthy. Their troops became hegemons among the feudal lords, combining and listing the lands of the states. Though they did not reach the declarations and oaths of the Three Dynasties, nevertheless they themselves were favored, and their lords were honored; they were famous and raised up in the current age. Can this not be called glory?
units.literal: From this after, famous scholars alternately rise, Jin used Jiu Fan, and Qi used Wang Zi, Wu used Sun Wu, explained clear army covenants, rewards punishments must trustworthy, troops hegemon feudal lords, combined listed state lands, though not reach three dynasties declarations oaths, however body favored lord honored, current age famous raised, can not call glory there?

units.zh: 豈與世儒闇於大較，不權輕重，猥云德化，不當用兵，大至君辱失守，小乃侵犯削弱，遂執不移等哉！
units.en: How can this compare with the Confucians of the world who are dark about the great outline, do not weigh light and heavy, foolishly speak of virtue transformation and say it is not proper to use weapons? In the great case, the lord is humiliated and loses his defense; in the small case, one is invaded and weakened. Then they hold to it unchangingly!
units.literal: How with world Confucians dark about great outline, not weigh light heavy, foolishly say virtue transformation, not proper use weapons, great to lord humiliated lose defense, small then invade weaken, then hold not move equal!

units.zh: 笔教笞不可廢於家，刑罰不可捐於國，誅伐不可偃於天下，用之有巧拙，行之有逆順耳。
units.en: Correction, instruction, and caning cannot be abandoned in the household; punishments cannot be discarded in the state; and military force cannot be set aside under Heaven. Their use may be skillful or clumsy; their execution may run against or with the grain.
units.literal: Writing teaching cane cannot abandon in family, punishments cannot discard in state, executions attacks cannot rest in realm, use have skillful clumsy, carry out have contrary compliant ears.

units.zh: 夏桀、殷紂手搏豺狼，足追四馬，勇非微也；
units.en: Xia Jie and Yin Zhou wrestled the jackals and wolves with their hands, chased the four horses with their feet—their bravery was not small.
units.literal: Xia Jie, Yin Zhou hand wrestled jackals wolves, feet chased four horses, bravery not small also;

units.zh: 百戰克勝，諸侯懾服，權非輕也。
units.en: They fought a hundred battles and overcame in victory; the feudal lords were awed and submitted—their authority was not light.
units.literal: Hundred battles overcome victory, feudal lords awed submit, authority not light also.

units.zh: 秦二世宿軍無用之地，連兵於邊陲，力非弱也；
units.en: Qin Er Shi stationed armies in useless places and kept troops connected at the borders; his strength was not slight.
units.literal: Qin Er Shi stationed armies useless lands, connected weapons at borders, strength not weak also.

units.zh: 結怨匈奴，絓禍於越，勢非寡也。
units.en: He incurred resentment with the Xiongnu and entangled disaster in Yue; his power was not slight.
units.literal: Formed resentment Xiongnu, entangled calamity in Yue, power not few also.

units.zh: 及其威盡勢極，閭巷之人為敵國，咎生窮武之不知足，甘得之心不息也。
units.en: When their awe was exhausted and their power at its limit, people in the alleys and lanes became enemy states. The blame arose from exhausting martial force without knowing when to stop; the heart set on gain did not cease.
units.literal: When their awe was exhausted and their power at its limit, people in the alleys and lanes became enemy states. The blame arose from exhausting martial force without knowing sufficiency; the heart set on gain did not cease.

units.zh: 高祖有天下，三邊外畔；
units.en: When Gaozu possessed all under Heaven, the three borders rebelled on the outside.
units.literal: Gaozu possessed realm, three borders external rebelled.

units.zh: 大國之王雖稱蕃輔，臣節未盡。
units.en: The kings of the great states, though called screen auxiliaries, did not complete their ministerly conduct.
units.literal: Great states kings though called screen auxiliaries, minister conduct not complete.

units.zh: 會高祖厭苦軍事，亦有蕭、張之謀，故偃武一休息，羈縻不備。
units.en: By then Gaozu was weary of military affairs, and he also had the advice of Xiao He and Zhang Liang. So he set aside military force for a time, keeping restraint and control but not yet fully completing them.
units.literal: Met Gaozu tired bitter military affairs, also had Xiao, Zhang plans, therefore rested martial one rest, restraint bridle not complete.

units.zh: 歷至孝文即位，將軍陳武等議曰：「南越、朝鮮自全秦時內屬為臣子，後且擁兵阻阸，選蠕觀望。
units.en: By the time Emperor Wen ascended the throne, General Chen Wu and others deliberated, saying, "Nanyue and Joseon had been subjects within the realm since the unified Qin. Later, they held troops, blocked the passes, and lingered in hesitation, watching from the sidelines.
units.literal: When it came to Emperor Wen's accession, General Chen Wu and others deliberated, saying: "Nanyue and Chaoxian, from the time of unified Qin, were subjects within the realm. Later they moreover held troops and blocked the passes, hesitating and watching from the sidelines.

units.zh: 高祖時天下新定，人民小安，未可復興兵。
units.en: In Gaozu's time, the realm was newly settled; the people were slightly peaceful. It was not possible to again raise weapons.
units.literal: Gaozu time realm newly settled, people slightly peaceful, not able again raise weapons.

units.zh: 今陛下仁惠撫百姓，恩澤加海內，宜及士民樂用，征討逆黨，以一封疆。」
units.en: Now Your Majesty is benevolent and kind, bringing comfort to the common people, and your grace reaches everywhere within the seas. We should act while scholars and commoners are eager to serve, campaign against the rebellious factions, and bring the frontiers into unity."
units.literal: Now Your Majesty is benevolent and kind, comforting the common people; grace and favor pervade within the seas. It is fitting to take advantage while scholars and the people are glad to serve, to campaign and attack the rebellious faction, and unify the borders."

units.zh: 孝文曰：「朕能任衣冠，念不到此。
units.en: Emperor Wen said, "I am able to wear the cap and gown, but my thoughts had not gone this far.
units.literal: Emperor Wen said: "I can bear the cap and gown, but my thoughts did not reach this.

units.zh: 會呂氏之亂，功臣宗室共不羞恥，誤居正位，常戰戰慄慄，恐事之不終。
units.en: When the turmoil of the Lü clan arose, I and the meritorious ministers and the imperial clan together held the throne without shame; we mistakenly occupied the legitimate position, constantly trembling in fear that the affair would not succeed.
units.literal: Met Lü clan chaos, meritorious ministers imperial clan together without shame, mistakenly occupied correct position, constantly trembling fearful, feared affairs not end.

units.zh: 且兵凶器，雖克所願，動亦秏病，謂百姓遠方何？
units.en: Besides, weapons are ominous tools. Even if one obtains what one wants, mobilization still exhausts and harms the people. What then of the common people and distant places?
units.literal: Moreover, weapons ominous tools, though overcome wished, move also consume illness, say common people distant places what?

units.zh: 又先帝知勞民不可煩，故不以為意。
units.en: The former emperor also knew that the people could not bear further labor, and therefore gave no thought to such a plan.
units.literal: Moreover, the former emperor knew the people could not be harassed with labor, and therefore gave no thought to this.

units.zh: 朕豈自謂能？
units.en: How can I myself say I am able?
units.literal: I how self say able?

units.zh: 今匈奴內侵，軍吏無功，邊民父子荷兵日久，朕常為動心傷痛，無日忘之。
units.en: Now the Xiongnu internally invade; the military officials have no merit; the border people, fathers and sons, carry weapons for days long. I am constantly moved in heart and pained; there is no day I forget it.
units.literal: Now Xiongnu internally invade, military officials no merit, border people fathers sons carry weapons days long, I constantly for moved heart pained, no day forget it.

units.zh: 今未能銷距，願且堅邊設候，結和通使，休寧北陲，為功多矣。
units.en: Since I cannot yet drive them back, for now I wish to strengthen the borders, establish watchposts, make peace, maintain envoys, and let the northern frontier rest in calm. That would already be a great achievement.
units.literal: Now unable to repel them, I wish for the present to strengthen the borders and set watchposts, form peace and maintain envoys, and let the northern frontier rest and settle; that would already be a great achievement.

units.zh: 且無議軍。」
units.en: And do not discuss military affairs."
units.literal: Moreover, do not discuss military affairs."

units.zh: 故百姓無內外之繇，得息肩於田畝，天下殷富，粟至十餘錢，鳴雞吠狗，煙火萬里，可謂和樂者乎！
units.en: Therefore, the common people had no labor service inside or outside the borders; they could rest their shoulders in the fields and on the farms. The realm was abundant and rich; millet sold for only ten or so cash. Roosters crowed and dogs barked, and smoke and hearthfires stretched for ten thousand li. Can this not be called harmonious and happy?
units.literal: Therefore, common people no internal external corvee, obtain rest shoulders in fields acres, realm abundant rich, millet reach ten several cash, crowing roosters barking dogs, smoke fires ten thousand li, can call harmonious happy ones!

units.zh: 太史公曰：文帝時，會天下新去湯火，人民樂業，因其欲然，能不擾亂，故百姓遂安。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: In Emperor Wen's time, all under Heaven had only just emerged from hardship; the people were content in their work. By following their wishes and avoiding disturbance, he was able to keep order, and so the common people became peaceful.
units.literal: Grand Historian says: Wen Emperor time, met realm newly gone hot water, people happy occupations, followed their desires thus, able not disturb chaos, therefore common people then peaceful.

units.zh: 自年六七十翁亦未嘗至市井，游敖嬉戲如小兒狀。
units.en: Even old men of sixty and seventy years also never reached the marketplaces; they strolled, played, and frolicked like children in appearance.
units.literal: Even year sixty seventy old men also never reached marketplaces, strolled played frolicked like children appearance.

units.zh: 孔子所稱有德君子者邪！
units.en: This is what Confucius praised as the virtuous gentleman!
units.literal: Confucius what praised virtuous gentleman ones!

units.zh: 《書》曰［七正］，二十八舍。
units.en: The Book says: 'Seven corrects, twenty-eight lodgings.'
units.literal: Book says seven correct, twenty eight lodgings.

units.zh: 律歷，天所以通五行八正之氣，天所以成孰萬物也。
units.en: Pitch-pipes and the calendar are how Heaven connects the qi of the five phases and the eight directions; Heaven thereby completes and ripens the ten thousand things.
units.literal: Pitchpipes calendar, heaven thus connect five phases eight correct qi, heaven thus complete mature ten thousand things also.

units.zh: 舍者，日月所舍。
units.en: The lodgings are where the sun and moon lodge.
units.literal: Lodging ones, sun moon what lodge.

units.zh: 舍者，舒氣也。
units.en: The lodgings are that which relaxes the qi.
units.literal: Lodging ones, relax qi also.

units.zh: 不周風居西北，主殺生。
units.en: The Imperfect Wind dwells in the northwest; it governs killing and living.
units.literal: Imperfect wind dwells northwest, governs killing living.

units.zh: 東壁居不周風東，主辟生氣而東之。
units.en: Eastern Wall dwells east of the Imperfect Wind; it governs avoiding the living qi and sending it east.
units.literal: Eastern wall dwells imperfect wind east, governs avoid living qi and east it.

units.zh: 至於營室。
units.en: It reaches Camp Room.
units.literal: Until camp room.

units.zh: 營室者，主營胎陽氣而產之。
units.en: Camp Room is that which governs nurturing the embryo yang qi and producing it.
units.literal: Camp room ones, govern nurture embryo yang qi and produce it.

units.zh: 東至于危。
units.en: It goes east until Wei.
units.literal: East until Wei.

units.zh: 危，垝也。
units.en: Wei means collapse.
units.literal: Wei, collapse also.

units.zh: 言陽氣之垝，故曰危。
units.en: It refers to the yang qi's collapse; therefore it is called Wei.
units.literal: It speaks of the yang qi's collapse; therefore it is called Wei.

units.zh: 十月也，律中應鐘。
units.en: The tenth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Yingzhong.
units.literal: Tenth month also, pitchpipe middle Yingzhong.

units.zh: 應鐘者，陽氣之應，不用事也。
units.en: Yingzhong is the response of the yang qi; it does not act in affairs.
units.literal: Yingzhong ones, yang qi respond, not use affairs also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為亥。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is hai.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is hai.

units.zh: 亥者，該也。
units.en: Hai means to encompass.
units.literal: Hai ones, encompass also.

units.zh: 言陽氣藏於下，故該也。
units.en: It refers to the yang qi hiding below; therefore it encompasses.
units.literal: Speak yang qi hide below, therefore encompass also.

units.zh: 廣莫風居北方。
units.en: The Guangmo Wind dwells in the north.
units.literal: Guangmo wind dwells northern.

units.zh: 廣莫者，言陽氣在下，陰莫陽廣大也，故曰廣莫。
units.en: Guangmo refers to the yang qi being below; when yin is none, yang is vast and great. Therefore, it is called Guangmo.
units.literal: Guangmo ones, speak yang qi in below, yin none yang vast great also, therefore called Guangmo.

units.zh: 東至於虛。
units.en: It goes east until Xu.
units.literal: East until Xu.

units.zh: 虛者，能實能虛，言陽氣冬則宛藏於虛，日冬至則一陰下藏，一陽上舒，故曰虛。
units.en: Xu is able to be solid and able to be empty. It refers to the yang qi in winter then curling and hiding in Xu. On the day of the winter solstice, then one yin hides below, one yang relaxes above. Therefore, it is called Xu.
units.literal: Xu ones, able solid able empty, speak yang qi winter then curled hide in Xu, sun winter solstice then one yin below hide, one yang above relax, therefore called Xu.

units.zh: 東至于須女。
units.en: It goes east until Xu Nu.
units.literal: East until Xu Nu.

units.zh: 言萬物變動其所，陰陽氣未相離，尚相胥也，故曰須女。
units.en: It refers to the ten thousand things changing and moving their place; the yin and yang qi have not yet mutually separated; they still mutually assist each other. Therefore, it is called Xu Nu.
units.literal: It says that the ten thousand things change and move their place; the yin and yang qi have not yet separated from each other and still assist each other. Therefore it is called Xu Nu.

units.zh: 十一月也，律中黃鐘。
units.en: The eleventh month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Huangzhong.
units.literal: Eleventh month also, pitchpipe middle Huangzhong.

units.zh: 黃鐘者，陽氣踵黃泉而出也。
units.en: Huangzhong is the yang qi following the Yellow Springs and emerging.
units.literal: Huangzhong ones, yang qi follows yellow springs and emerges also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為子。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is zi.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is zi.

units.zh: 子者，滋也；
units.en: Zi means to nourish.
units.literal: Zi ones, nourish also;

units.zh: 滋者，言萬物滋於下也。
units.en: Nourishing refers to the ten thousand things nourishing below.
units.literal: Nourish ones, speak ten thousand things nourish below also.

units.zh: 其於十母為壬癸。
units.en: Among the ten mothers, it is Ren and Gui.
units.literal: Its at ten mothers is Ren Gui.

units.zh: 壬之為言任也，言陽氣任養萬物於下也。
units.en: Ren means to bear; it refers to the yang qi bearing and nourishing the ten thousand things below.
units.literal: Ren of speak bear also, speak yang qi bears nourishes ten thousand things below also.

units.zh: 癸之為言揆也，言萬物可揆度，故曰癸。
units.en: Gui means to measure; it refers to the ten thousand things being measurable and assessable. Therefore, it is called Gui.
units.literal: Gui of speak measure also, speak ten thousand things can measure degree, therefore called Gui.

units.zh: 東至牽牛。
units.en: It goes east to Ox Leader.
units.literal: East until Ox Leader.

units.zh: 牽牛者，言陽氣牽引萬物出之也。
units.en: Ox Leader refers to the yang qi pulling and leading the ten thousand things into emergence.
units.literal: Ox Leader ones, speak yang qi pulls leads ten thousand things emerge it also.

units.zh: 牛者，冒也，言地雖凍，能冒而生也。
units.en: Ox means to break through. It refers to the earth, which though frozen can still break through and give life.
units.literal: Ox means to break through; it speaks of the earth, which though frozen can still break through and give life.

units.zh: 牛者，耕植種萬物也。
units.en: Ox is that which plows, plants, and sows the ten thousand things.
units.literal: Ox ones, plow plant sow ten thousand things also.

units.zh: 東至於建星。
units.en: It goes east to Jian Star.
units.literal: East until Jian Star.

units.zh: 建星者，建諸生也。
units.en: Jian Star is that which establishes living things.
units.literal: Jian Star ones, establish various living also.

units.zh: 十二月也，律中大呂。
units.en: The twelfth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Dalu.
units.literal: Twelfth month also, pitchpipe middle Dali.

units.zh: 大呂者。
units.en: Dalu.
units.literal: Dalu ones.

units.zh: 其於十二子爲丑。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is chou.
units.literal: Among the twelve branches, it is chou.

units.zh: 條風居東北，主出萬物。
units.en: The Tiao Wind dwells in the northeast; it governs the emergence of the ten thousand things.
units.literal: Tiao wind dwells northeast, governs emerge ten thousand things.

units.zh: 條之言條治萬物而出之，故曰條風。
units.en: Tiao means to arrange and govern the ten thousand things and bring them forth. Therefore, it is called the Tiao Wind.
units.literal: Tiao of speak arrange govern ten thousand things and emerge it, therefore called Tiao wind.

units.zh: 南至於箕。
units.en: It goes south to Ji.
units.literal: South until Ji.

units.zh: 箕者，言萬物根棋，故曰箕。
units.en: Ji refers to the ten thousand things' roots spread out like a lattice. Therefore, it is called Ji.
units.literal: Ji ones, speak ten thousand things roots dispersed, therefore called Ji.

units.zh: 正月也，律中泰蔟。
units.en: The first month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Taicu.
units.literal: First month also, pitchpipe middle Tai Cu.

units.zh: 泰蔟者，言萬物蔟生也，故曰泰蔟。
units.en: Taicu refers to the ten thousand things clustering and springing to life. Therefore, it is called Taicu.
units.literal: Tai Cu ones, speak ten thousand things clustered live also, therefore called Tai Cu.

units.zh: 其於十二子為寅。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Yin.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Yin.

units.zh: 寅言萬物始生螾然也，故曰寅。
units.en: Yin refers to the ten thousand things beginning to live with a wriggling appearance. Therefore, it is called Yin.
units.literal: Yin speak ten thousand things begin live wriggling appearance also, therefore called Yin.

units.zh: 南至於尾，言萬物始生如尾也。
units.en: It goes south to Tail. It refers to the ten thousand things beginning to live like a tail.
units.literal: South until Tail, speak ten thousand things begin live like tail also.

units.zh: 南至於心，言萬物始生有華心也。
units.en: It goes south to Heart. It refers to the ten thousand things beginning to live and having a flowery heart.
units.literal: South until Heart, speak ten thousand things begin live have flowery heart also.

units.zh: 南至於房。
units.en: It goes south to Fang.
units.literal: South until Fang.

units.zh: 房者，言萬物門戶也，至于門則出矣。
units.en: Fang refers to the ten thousand things' door and gate. When they reach the gate, they emerge.
units.literal: Fang ones, speak ten thousand things door gate also, arrive at gate then emerge already.

units.zh: 明庶風居東方。
units.en: The Ming Shu Wind dwells in the east.
units.literal: Ming Shu wind dwells eastern.

units.zh: 明庶者，明眾物盡出也。
units.en: Ming Shu means to brighten all things so they emerge completely.
units.literal: Ming Shu ones, bright all things completely emerge also.

units.zh: 二月也，律中夾鐘。
units.en: The second month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Jiazhong.
units.literal: Second month also, pitchpipe middle Jia Zhong.

units.zh: 夾鐘者，言陰陽相夾廁也。
units.en: Jiazhong refers to yin and yang being interleaved with one another.
units.literal: Jia Zhong ones, speak yin yang mutually sandwiched mixed also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為卯。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Mao.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Mao.

units.zh: 卯之為言茂也，言萬物茂也。
units.en: Mao means luxuriant. It refers to the ten thousand things being luxuriant.
units.literal: Mao of speak luxuriant also, speak ten thousand things luxuriant also.

units.zh: 其於十母為甲乙。
units.en: Among the ten stems, it is Jia and Yi.
units.literal: Its at ten mothers is Jia Yi.

units.zh: 甲者，言萬物剖符甲而出也；
units.en: Jia refers to the ten thousand things splitting their shell and emerging.
units.literal: Jia ones, speak ten thousand things split tally armor and emerge also;

units.zh: 乙者，言萬物生軋軋也。
units.en: Yi refers to the ten thousand things living with a grinding sound.
units.literal: Yi ones, speak ten thousand things live grinding grinding also.

units.zh: 南至于氐者。
units.en: It goes south to Di.
units.literal: South until Di ones.

units.zh: 氐者，言萬物皆至也。
units.en: Di refers to the ten thousand things all arriving.
units.literal: Di ones, speak ten thousand things all arrive also.

units.zh: 南至於亢。
units.en: It goes south to Kang.
units.literal: South until Kang.

units.zh: 亢者，言萬物亢見也。
units.en: Kang refers to the ten thousand things being high and visible.
units.literal: Kang ones, speak ten thousand things high see also.

units.zh: 南至于角。
units.en: It goes south to Jiao.
units.literal: South until Jiao.

units.zh: 角者，言萬物皆有枝格如角也。
units.en: Jiao refers to the ten thousand things all having branches and frames like horns.
units.literal: Jiao ones, speak ten thousand things all have branch frame like horn also.

units.zh: 三月也，律中姑洗。
units.en: The third month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Guxi.
units.literal: Third month also, pitchpipe middle Gu Xi.

units.zh: 姑洗者，言萬物洗生。
units.en: Guxi refers to the ten thousand things being washed clean into life.
units.literal: Gu Xi ones, speak ten thousand things wash live.

units.zh: 其於十二子為辰。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Chen.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Chen.

units.zh: 辰者，言萬物之蜄也。
units.en: Chen refers to the ten thousand things' growth at dawn.
units.literal: Chen ones, speak ten thousand things of morning also.

units.zh: 清明風居東南維，主風吹萬物而西之。
units.en: The Qingming Wind dwells in the southeast corner; it governs the wind that blows the ten thousand things west.
units.literal: Qingming wind dwells southeast corner, governs wind blow ten thousand things and west it.

units.zh: ［至於］軫。
units.en: It reaches Zhen.
units.literal: Until Zhen.

units.zh: 軫者，言萬物益大而軫軫然。
units.en: Zhen refers to the ten thousand things becoming increasingly large and full.
units.literal: Zhen ones, speak ten thousand things increasingly big and Zhen Zhen appearance.

units.zh: 西至於翼。
units.en: It goes west to Yi.
units.literal: West until Yi.

units.zh: 翼者，言萬物皆有羽翼也。
units.en: Yi refers to the ten thousand things all having feathered wings.
units.literal: Yi ones, speak ten thousand things all have feather wings also.

units.zh: 四月也，律中中呂。
units.en: The fourth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Zhonglü.
units.literal: Fourth month also, pitchpipe middle Zhong Lü.

units.zh: 中呂者，言萬物盡旅而西行也。
units.en: Zhonglü refers to the ten thousand things all gathering and going west.
units.literal: Zhong Lü ones, speak ten thousand things all group and west go also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為巳。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Si.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Si.

units.zh: 巳者，言陽氣之已盡也。
units.en: Si refers to the yang qi being already exhausted.
units.literal: Si ones, speak yang qi of already exhausted also.

units.zh: 西至于七星。
units.en: It goes west to Seven Stars.
units.literal: West until Seven Stars.

units.zh: 七星者，陽數成於七，故曰七星。
units.en: Seven Stars means the yang number is completed in seven. Therefore, it is called Seven Stars.
units.literal: Seven Stars ones, yang number completes at seven, therefore called Seven Stars.

units.zh: 西至于張。
units.en: It goes west to Zhang.
units.literal: West until Zhang.

units.zh: 張者，言萬物皆張也。
units.en: Zhang refers to the ten thousand things all stretching outward.
units.literal: Zhang ones, speak ten thousand things all stretch also.

units.zh: 西至于注。
units.en: It goes west to Zhu.
units.literal: West until Zhu.

units.zh: 注者，言萬物之始衰，陽氣下注，故曰注。
units.en: Zhu refers to the ten thousand things beginning to decline; the yang qi pours downward. Therefore, it is called Zhu.
units.literal: Zhu ones, speak ten thousand things of begin decline, yang qi down pour, therefore called Zhu.

units.zh: 五月也，律中蕤賓。
units.en: The fifth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Ruibin.
units.literal: Fifth month also, pitchpipe middle Rui Bin.

units.zh: 蕤賓者，言陰氣幼少，故曰蕤；
units.en: Ruibin refers to the yin qi being young and few. Therefore, it is called Rui.
units.literal: Rui Bin ones, speak yin qi young few, therefore called Rui;

units.zh: 痿陽不用事，故曰賓。
units.en: The withered yang does not act. Therefore, it is called Bin.
units.literal: Withered yang not use affairs, therefore called Bin.

units.zh: 景風居南方。
units.en: The Jing Wind dwells in the south.
units.literal: Jing wind dwells southern.

units.zh: 景者，言陽氣道竟，故曰景風。
units.en: Jing refers to the yang qi's course being exhausted. Therefore, it is called the Jing Wind.
units.literal: Jing ones, speak yang qi way exhaust, therefore called Jing wind.

units.zh: 其於十二子為午。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Wu.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Wu.

units.zh: 午者，陰陽交，故曰午。
units.en: Wu means yin and yang intersect. Therefore, it is called Wu.
units.literal: Wu ones, yin yang intersect, therefore called Wu.

units.zh: 其於十母為丙丁。
units.en: Among the ten stems, it is Bing and Ding.
units.literal: Its at ten mothers is Bing Ding.

units.zh: 丙者，言陽道著明，故曰丙；
units.en: Bing refers to the yang path manifesting clearly. Therefore, it is called Bing.
units.literal: Bing ones, speak yang way manifest bright, therefore called Bing;

units.zh: 丁者，言萬物之丁壯也，故曰丁。
units.en: Ding refers to the ten thousand things' vigor and strength. Therefore, it is called Ding.
units.literal: Ding ones, speak ten thousand things of Ding Zhuang also, therefore called Ding.

units.zh: 西至于弧。
units.en: It goes west to Hu.
units.literal: West until Hu.

units.zh: 弧者，言萬物之吳落且就死也。
units.en: Hu refers to the ten thousand things withering and falling and approaching death.
units.literal: Hu speaks of the ten thousand things withering and falling and approaching death.

units.zh: 西至于狼。
units.en: It goes west to Wolf.
units.literal: West until Wolf.

units.zh: 狼者，言萬物可度量，斷萬物，故曰狼。
units.en: Wolf refers to the ten thousand things being measurable and assessable, and of cutting them off. Therefore, it is called Wolf.
units.literal: Wolf ones, speak ten thousand things can measure quantity, cut ten thousand things, therefore called Wolf.

units.zh: 涼風居西南維，主地。
units.en: The Cool Wind dwells in the southwest corner; it governs the earth.
units.literal: Cool wind dwells southwest corner, governs earth.

units.zh: 地者，沈奪萬物氣也。
units.en: Earth is what sinks and seizes the ten thousand things' qi.
units.literal: Earth ones, sink seize ten thousand things qi also.

units.zh: 六月也，律中林鐘。
units.en: The sixth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Linzhong.
units.literal: Sixth month also, pitchpipe middle Lin Zhong.

units.zh: 林鐘者，言萬物就死氣林林然。
units.en: Linzhong refers to the ten thousand things approaching death qi in a dense, clustered way.
units.literal: Lin Zhong ones, speak ten thousand things approach death qi Lin Lin appearance.

units.zh: 其於十二子為未。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Wei.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Wei.

units.zh: 未者，言萬物皆成，有滋味也。
units.en: Wei refers to the ten thousand things all being complete and having flavor.
units.literal: Wei ones, speak ten thousand things all complete, have flavors also.

units.zh: 北至於罰。
units.en: It goes north to Fa.
units.literal: North until Fa.

units.zh: 罰者，言萬物氣奪可伐也。
units.en: Fa refers to the ten thousand things' qi being seized and liable to attack.
units.literal: Fa ones, speak ten thousand things qi seize can attack also.

units.zh: 北至於參。
units.en: It goes north to Shen.
units.literal: North until Shen.

units.zh: 參言萬物可參也，故曰參。
units.en: Shen refers to the ten thousand things being comparable. Therefore, it is called Shen.
units.literal: Shen speak ten thousand things can compare also, therefore called Shen.

units.zh: 七月也，律中夷則。
units.en: The seventh month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Yize.
units.literal: Seventh month also, pitchpipe middle Yi Ze.

units.zh: 夷則，言陰氣之賊萬物也。
units.en: Yize refers to the yin qi harming the ten thousand things.
units.literal: Yi Ze, speak yin qi of harm ten thousand things also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為申。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Shen.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Shen.

units.zh: 申者，言陰用事，申賊萬物，故曰申。
units.en: Shen refers to yin taking charge and harming the ten thousand things. Therefore, it is called Shen.
units.literal: Shen ones, speak yin use affairs, Shen harm ten thousand things, therefore called Shen.

units.zh: 北至於濁。
units.en: It goes north to Zhu.
units.literal: North until Zhu.

units.zh: 濁者，觸也，言萬物皆觸死也，故曰濁。
units.en: Zhu means to touch. It refers to the ten thousand things all touching death. Therefore, it is called Zhu.
units.literal: Zhu ones, touch also, speak ten thousand things all touch death also, therefore called Zhu.

units.zh: 北至於留。
units.en: It goes north to Liu.
units.literal: North until Liu.

units.zh: 留者，言陽氣之稽留也，故曰留。
units.en: Liu refers to the yang qi being detained and lingering. Therefore, it is called Liu.
units.literal: Liu ones, speak yang qi of detain stay also, therefore called Liu.

units.zh: 八月也，律中南呂。
units.en: The eighth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Nanlü.
units.literal: Eighth month also, pitchpipe middle Nan Lü.

units.zh: 南呂者，言陽氣之旅入藏也。
units.en: Nanlü refers to the yang qi entering and hiding in groups.
units.literal: Nan Lü ones, speak yang qi of group enter hide also.

units.zh: 其於十二子為酉。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is You.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is You.

units.zh: 酉者，萬物之老也，故曰酉。
units.en: The tenth branch refers to the ten thousand things' old age. Therefore, it is called You.
units.literal: You ones, ten thousand things of old also, therefore called You.

units.zh: 閶闔風居西方。
units.en: The Changhe Wind dwells in the west.
units.literal: Chang He wind dwells western.

units.zh: 閶者，倡也；
units.en: Chang means to lead.
units.literal: Chang ones, lead also;

units.zh: 闔者，藏也。
units.en: He means to hide.
units.literal: He ones, hide also.

units.zh: 言陽氣道萬物，闔黃泉也。
units.en: It refers to the yang qi leading the ten thousand things and closing off the Yellow Springs.
units.literal: Speak yang qi lead ten thousand things, he yellow springs also.

units.zh: 其於十母為庚辛。
units.en: Among the ten stems, it is Geng and Xin.
units.literal: Its at ten mothers is Geng Xin.

units.zh: 庚者，言陰氣庚萬物，故曰庚；
units.en: Geng refers to the yin qi transforming the ten thousand things. Therefore, it is called Geng.
units.literal: Geng ones, speak yin qi Geng ten thousand things, therefore called Geng;

units.zh: 辛者，言萬物之辛生，故曰辛。
units.en: Xin refers to the ten thousand things' new growth. Therefore, it is called Xin.
units.literal: Xin ones, speak ten thousand things of Xin live, therefore called Xin.

units.zh: 北至於胃。
units.en: It goes north to Wei.
units.literal: North until Wei.

units.zh: 胃者，言陽氣就藏，皆胃胃也。
units.en: Wei refers to the yang qi approaching concealment; everything is gathered and stored.
units.literal: Wei ones, speak yang qi approach hide, all Wei Wei also.

units.zh: 北至於婁。
units.en: It goes north to Lou.
units.literal: North until Lou.

units.zh: 婁者，呼萬物且內之也。
units.en: Lou summons the ten thousand things and brings them inward.
units.literal: Lou ones, call ten thousand things moreover enter it also.

units.zh: 北至於奎。
units.en: It goes north to Kui.
units.literal: North until Kui.

units.zh: 奎者，主毒螫殺萬物也，奎而藏之。
units.en: Kui governs the poison sting that kills the ten thousand things; it gathers and hides them.
units.literal: Kui ones, govern poison sting kill ten thousand things also, Kui and hide it.

units.zh: 九月也，律中無射。
units.en: The ninth month: the pitch-pipe in the middle is Wushe.
units.literal: Ninth month also, pitchpipe middle Wu She.

units.zh: 無射者，陰氣盛用事，陽氣無餘也，故曰無射。
units.en: Wushe means the yin qi flourishes and takes charge, while the yang qi has no remainder. Therefore, it is called Wushe.
units.literal: Wu She ones, yin qi flourish use affairs, yang qi no remainder also, therefore called Wu She.

units.zh: 其於十二子為戌。
units.en: Among the twelve branches, it is Xu.
units.literal: Its at twelve branches is Xu.

units.zh: 戌者，言萬物盡滅，故曰戌。
units.en: Xu refers to the ten thousand things being exhausted and extinguished. Therefore, it is called Xu.
units.literal: Xu ones, speak ten thousand things exhaust extinguish, therefore called Xu.

units.zh: 律數：九九八十一以為宮。
units.en: The pitch-pipe numbers are: nine times nine equals eighty-one, which makes the gong note.
units.literal: Pitchpipe numbers: nine nine eighty one to make palace.

units.zh: 三分去一，五十四以為徵。
units.en: Remove one part from three, making fifty-four, which makes the zhi note.
units.literal: Three parts remove one, fifty four to make zheng.

units.zh: 三分益一，七十二以為商。
units.en: Add one part to three, making seventy-two, which makes the shang note.
units.literal: Three parts add one, seventy two to make shang.

units.zh: 三分去一，四十八以為羽。
units.en: Remove one part from three, making forty-eight, which makes the yu note.
units.literal: Three parts remove one, forty eight to make yu.

units.zh: 三分益一，六十四以為角。
units.en: Add one part to three, making sixty-four, which makes the jiao note.
units.literal: Three parts add one, sixty four to make jiao.

units.zh: 黃鐘長八寸七分一，宮。
units.en: Huangzhong is eight inches and one-seventh of an inch long; it is the gong note.
units.literal: Huangzhong length eight inch seven parts one, palace.

units.zh: 大呂長七寸五分三分二。
units.en: Dalu measures seven inches, five parts, and two-thirds of a part.
units.literal: Dalu is seven inches, five parts, and two-thirds of a part long.

units.zh: 太蔟長七寸十分二，角。
units.en: Tai Cu is seven inches and two-tenths of an inch long; it is the jiao note.
units.literal: Tai Cu length seven inch ten parts two, horn.

units.zh: 夾鐘長六寸七分三分一。
units.en: Jia Zhong is six inches, seven parts, and one-third of a part long.
units.literal: Jia Zhong length six inch seven parts three parts one.

units.zh: 姑洗長六寸十分四，羽。
units.en: Gu Xi is six inches and four-tenths of an inch long; it is the yu note.
units.literal: Gu Xi length six inch ten parts four, feather.

units.zh: 仲呂長五寸九分三分二，徵。
units.en: Zhong Lü is five inches, nine parts, and two-thirds of a part long; it is the zhi note.
units.literal: Zhong Lü length five inch nine parts three parts two, zheng.

units.zh: 蕤賓長五寸六分三分二。
units.en: Ruibin is five inches, six parts, and two-thirds of a part long.
units.literal: Rui Bin length five inch six parts three parts two.

units.zh: 林鐘長五寸十分四，角。
units.en: Lin Zhong is five inches and four-tenths of an inch long; it is the jiao note.
units.literal: Lin Zhong length five inch ten parts four, horn.

units.zh: 夷則長五寸四分三分二，商。
units.en: Yi Ze is five inches, four parts, and two-thirds of a part long; it is the shang note.
units.literal: Yi Ze length five inch four parts three parts two, shang.

units.zh: 南呂長四寸十分八，徵。
units.en: Nan Lü is four inches and eight-tenths of an inch long; it is the zhi note.
units.literal: Nan Lü length four inch ten parts eight, zheng.

units.zh: 無射長四寸四分三分二。
units.en: Wu She is four inches, four parts, and two-thirds of a part long.
units.literal: Wu She length four inch four parts three parts two.

units.zh: 應鐘長四寸二分三分二，羽。
units.en: Ying Zhong is four inches, two parts, and two-thirds of a part long; it is the yu note.
units.literal: Ying Zhong length four inch two parts three parts two, feather.

units.zh: 生鐘分：子一分。
units.en: The fractions for generating the bells are as follows: zi is one part.
units.literal: The parts for generating the bells: zi is one part.

units.zh: 丑三分二。
units.en: Chou is two-thirds of a part.
units.literal: Chou three parts two.

units.zh: 寅九分八。
units.en: Yin is eight-ninths of a part.
units.literal: Yin nine parts eight.

units.zh: 卯二十七分十六。
units.en: Mao is sixteen twenty-sevenths of a part.
units.literal: Mao twenty seven parts sixteen.

units.zh: 辰八十一分六十四。
units.en: Chen is sixty-four eighty-firsts of a part.
units.literal: Chen eighty one parts sixty four.

units.zh: 巳二百四十三分一百二十八。
units.en: Si is one hundred twenty-eight two-hundred-forty-thirds of a part.
units.literal: Si two hundred forty three parts one hundred twenty eight.

units.zh: 午七百二十九分五百一十二。
units.en: Wu is five hundred twelve seven-hundred-twenty-ninths of a part.
units.literal: Wu seven hundred twenty nine parts five hundred twelve.

units.zh: 未二千一百八十七分一千二十四。
units.en: Wei is one thousand twenty-four two-thousand-one-hundred-eighty-sevenths of a part.
units.literal: Wei two thousand one hundred eighty seven parts one thousand twenty four.

units.zh: 申六千五百六十一分四千九十六。
units.en: Shen is 4,096/6,561 of a part.
units.literal: Shen six thousand five hundred sixty one parts four thousand ninety six.

units.zh: 酉一萬九千六百八十三分八千一百九十二。
units.en: The tenth branch is eight thousand one hundred ninety-two nineteen-thousand-six-hundred-eighty-thirds of a part.
units.literal: You ten thousand nine thousand six hundred eighty three parts eight thousand one hundred ninety two.

units.zh: 戌五萬九千四十九分三萬二千七百六十八。
units.en: Xu is thirty-two thousand seven hundred sixty-eight fifty-nine-thousand-forty-ninths of a part.
units.literal: Xu fifty nine thousand forty nine parts thirty two thousand seven hundred sixty eight.

units.zh: 亥十七萬七千一百四十七分六萬五千五百三十六。
units.en: Hai is sixty-five thousand five hundred thirty-six one-hundred-seventy-seven-thousand-one-hundred-forty-sevenths of a part.
units.literal: Hai one hundred seventy seven thousand one hundred forty seven parts sixty five thousand five hundred thirty six.

units.zh: 生黃鐘術曰：以下生者，倍其實，三其法。
units.en: The method for generating Huangzhong says: when generating downward, double the numerator and triple the denominator.
units.literal: The method for generating Huangzhong says: for those generated below, double the numerator and triple the denominator.

units.zh: 以上生者，四其實，三其法。
units.en: For those generated above, multiply their numerator by four and triple their denominator.
units.literal: Above living ones, four their real, three their method.

units.zh: 上九，商八，羽七，角六，宮五，徵九。
units.en: The upper note is nine; the shang note is eight; the yu note is seven; the jiao note is six; the gong note is five; the zhi note is nine.
units.literal: Upper nine; shang eight; yu seven; jiao six; gong five; zhi nine.

units.zh: 置一而九三之以為法。
units.en: Set one and triple it nine times to make the denominator.
units.literal: Place one and nine triple it to make method.

units.zh: 實如法，得長一寸。
units.en: When the numerator equals the denominator, one obtains a length of one inch.
units.literal: Real like method, obtain length one inch.

units.zh: 凡得九寸，命曰「黃鐘之宮」。
units.en: When one obtains nine inches in all, it is named "Huangzhong's gong."
units.literal: All obtain nine inches, name called "Huangzhong of palace".

units.zh: 故曰音始於宮，窮於角；
units.en: Therefore, the saying goes that sound begins with gong and is exhausted at jiao.
units.literal: Therefore, called sound begins at palace, exhausts at horn;

units.zh: 數始於一，終於十，成於三；
units.en: Numbers begin at one, end at ten, and are completed at three.
units.literal: Numbers begin at one, end at ten, complete at three;

units.zh: 氣始於冬至，周而復生。
units.en: Qi begins at the winter solstice, cycles, and is born again.
units.literal: Qi begins at winter solstice, cycles and again lives.

units.zh: 神生於無，形成於有，形然後數，形而成聲，故曰神使氣，氣就形。
units.en: Spirit is born from nothing; form is created from being. The form then has numbers; the form then becomes sound. Therefore, the saying goes that spirit makes qi, and qi approaches form.
units.literal: Spirit lives from nothing, forms from having, form then numbers, form then becomes sound, therefore called spirit makes qi, qi approaches form.

units.zh: 形理如類有可類。
units.en: The principle of form is like categories; there is what can be categorized.
units.literal: Form principle like categories have what can categorize.

units.zh: 或未形而未類，或同形而同類，類而可班，類而可識。
units.en: Some have not yet taken shape and are not yet categorized; some have the same form and the same category. Once categorized, they can be arranged; once identified, they can be recognized.
units.literal: Either not yet formed and not yet categorized, or same form and same category, categorize and can arrange, categorize and can recognize.

units.zh: 聖人知天地識之別，故從有以至未有，以得細若氣，微若聲。
units.en: Sages know the distinction between heaven and earth. Therefore, they proceed from being to non-being, to obtain what is fine like qi and subtle like sound.
units.literal: Sages know heaven earth recognize their distinction, therefore from having reach not having, to obtain fine like qi, subtle like sound.

units.zh: 然聖人因神而存之，雖妙必效情，核其華道者明矣。
units.en: Yet sages follow the spirit and preserve it. Though marvelous, they must imitate emotions and examine the flowery way. This is clear.
units.literal: Yet sages follow spirit and preserve it, though marvelous must imitate emotions, examine their flowery way ones clear already.

units.zh: 非有聖心以乘聰明，孰能存天地之神而成形之情哉？
units.en: Without a sage heart to ride intelligence and wisdom, who can preserve the spirit of heaven and earth and complete the emotions of form?
units.literal: Not having sage heart to ride intelligence wisdom, who can preserve heaven earth spirit and complete form emotions?

units.zh: 神者，物受之而不能知（及）其去來，故聖人畏而欲存之。
units.en: Spirit is that which things receive but cannot know its coming and going. Therefore, the sages fear it and desire to preserve it.
units.literal: Spirit ones, things receive it but cannot know their coming going, therefore sages fear and desire preserve it.

units.zh: 唯欲存之，神之亦存。
units.en: Only when one desires to preserve it can spirit also be preserved.
units.literal: Only by desiring to preserve it is spirit also preserved.

units.zh: 其欲存之者，故莫貴焉。
units.en: Those who desire to preserve it, therefore nothing is more precious than this.
units.literal: Their desire preserve it ones, therefore nothing precious there.

units.zh: 太史公曰：（故）［在］旋璣玉衡以齊七政，即天地二十八宿。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: By using the whirling jade balance to regulate the seven governing luminaries, one aligns the twenty-eight lodgings of heaven and earth.
units.literal: Grand Historian says: In whirling jade balance to align seven governments, namely heaven earth twenty eight lodgings.

units.zh: 十母，十二子，鐘律調自上古。
units.en: The ten mothers and twelve children have harmonized the bell pitch-pipes since high antiquity.
units.literal: Ten mothers, twelve children, bell pitchpipes harmonize from high antiquity.

units.zh: 建律運歷造日度，可據而度也。
units.en: By establishing the pitch-pipes, moving the calendar, and setting the sun's degrees, one can rely on them for measurement.
units.literal: Establish pitchpipes move calendar make sun degrees, can rely and measure also.

units.zh: 合符節，通道德，即從斯之謂也。
units.en: Combining tallies and sections, and joining morality with virtue: this is what it means to follow this.
units.literal: Combine tally sections, connect morality virtue, namely follow this of called also.
